# ProfileConnectionSource

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Auth.Pooling.ProfileConnectionSource`

Creates a new ProfileConnectionSource.

- Parameter `profile`: The authentication profile.
- Parameter `environmentUrl`: The Dataverse environment URL.
- Parameter `maxPoolSize`: Maximum pool size (default: 52 per Microsoft recommendations).
- Parameter `deviceCodeCallback`: Optional callback for device code display.
- Parameter `beforeInteractiveAuth`: Optional callback invoked before browser opens for interactive auth. Returns the user&#x27;s choice (OpenBrowser, UseDeviceCode, or Cancel).
- Parameter `environmentDisplayName`: Optional environment display name for connection naming.
- Parameter `credentialStore`: Optional secure credential store for looking up secrets.
- Parameter `clientSecretOverride`: Optional client secret override (bypasses env var and store lookups).
- Parameter `onProfileUpdated`: Optional callback invoked when profile metadata is updated (e.g., HomeAccountId after auth).

#### InvalidateSeed

```text
public System.Void InvalidateSeed()
```

Invalidates the cached seed client, forcing fresh authentication on next use.


Remarks: Call this when a token failure is detected. The next call to GetSeedClient will create a new client with fresh authentication instead of returning the cached one.

#### FromProfile

```text
public static PPDS.Auth.Pooling.ProfileConnectionSource FromProfile(PPDS.Auth.Profiles.AuthProfile profile, System.Int32 maxPoolSize = 52, System.Action`1<PPDS.Auth.Credentials.DeviceCodeInfo> deviceCodeCallback = default, System.Func`2<System.Action`1<PPDS.Auth.Credentials.DeviceCodeInfo>,PPDS.Auth.Credentials.PreAuthDialogResult> beforeInteractiveAuth = default, PPDS.Auth.Credentials.ISecureCredentialStore credentialStore = default, System.Action`1<PPDS.Auth.Profiles.AuthProfile> onProfileUpdated = default)
```

Creates a ProfileConnectionSource from a profile, using the profile&#x27;s environment.

- Parameter `profile`: The authentication profile (must have environment set).
- Parameter `maxPoolSize`: Maximum pool size.
- Parameter `deviceCodeCallback`: Optional callback for device code display.
- Parameter `beforeInteractiveAuth`: Optional callback invoked before browser opens for interactive auth. Returns the user&#x27;s choice (OpenBrowser, UseDeviceCode, or Cancel).
- Parameter `credentialStore`: Optional secure credential store for looking up secrets.
- Parameter `onProfileUpdated`: Optional callback invoked when profile metadata is updated (e.g., HomeAccountId after auth).

Returns: A new connection source.
